mechanism: Sertraline inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing fluphenazine levels; combined serotonergic and dopamine antagonist effects increase neuroleptic-related adverse events including extrapyramidal symptoms and QT prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, and cardiac arrhythmias; consider dose reduction of fluphenazine or use alternative antipsychotic with less CYP450 interaction; obtain baseline and periodic ECG.
